name: web-static-vercel
label: Static page + one function
summary: Static page plus one Vercel function, npm, node --test, no database.
skill_rows: | `/security-pass [url]` | dependency audit, secret scan, off-origin calls, headers on a live URL, then the security reviewer | a verdict |
| `/deploy-web` | runbook for CI, preview and production deploys of the static page plus its functions (push to main = deploy) | confirmation the deploy landed |
after_steps: run npm run lint and report its result
run npm test and report its result
run SMOKE_TIMING=off npm run smoke and report its result
make one commit of the working tree in the repository's whole-sentence style
git push to the upstream branch; a push to main deploys
one_time_steps: Vercel: create the project with framework Other, no build command and output directory src, and do not connect it to GitHub; note its org id and project id.
GitHub: set VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID and VERCEL_PROJECT_ID as repository secrets.
Git: the folder is a git repository with a main branch on GitHub, and .github/vercel-cli/package-lock.json is committed before the first push to main, which is the first deploy.
